photos.description: Westfield World Trade Center, also known as the Oculus, is a shopping mall at the World Trade Center complex in Manhattan, New York. Opened in 2016, the mall replaced the original shopping center under the World Trade Center, and is currently the largest shopping complex in Manhattan.
